newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare stake raised by N.J. investor.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare stake raised by N.J. investor.

text.p: A group led by Robert Horowitz, a Glen Rock, N.J., investor said Tuesday it raised its stake in RehabCare Group Inc to 317,100 common shares or 8.4 percent from 6.6 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 8,500 common shares between February 14 and March 3 at prices ranging from $21.254 to $22.257 per share.
The stake is being acquired for investment purposes.
Following RehabCare's buyback of 999,955 common on March 12, outstanding shares rose to 3,768,127 common.
RehabCare, based in St. Louis, Mo., provides acute rehabilitation, subacute, outpatient and therapist staffing services on a contract basis.
